title: Nerve
description: Partnered with a mysterious stranger (Dave Franco), a high school senior (Emma Roberts) joins a popular online game that dares players to perform increasingly dangerous stunts.

title: Scream
description: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity.

title: Girls Trip
description: Four best friends travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush.

title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
description: Twentieth-century teenagers (Leonardo DiCaprio, Claire Danes) fall in love, despite feuding families, in an update of the classic tragedy.

title: Architecton
description: A hypnotic, propulsive odyssey through the foundations of the modern world, following mountains as they are turned into concrete and buildings as they are turned into rubble.

title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
description: Trapped in digital space by a rogue AI, superstar LeBron James teams up with Bugs Bunny and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad.

title: The Hobbit
description: An animated adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien's tale of the adventures of a hobbit on a quest to regain a dwarf king's gold.

title: Fantastic Beasts: A Natural History
description: Delving into the mythological, including dragons, mermaids, and unicorns -- alongside examinations of natural world beasts, such as vervet monkeys, narwhals, and manatees; Stephen Fry travels far and wide to learn about such animals.

title: The Mountain Between Us
description: Stranded on a mountain after a plane crash, two strangers must work together to survive the extreme elements of the remote, snow-covered terrain. Realizing that help is not on the way, they embark on a perilous journey across hundreds of miles.

title: The Way, Way Back
description: After his mother's lover (Steve Carell) belittles him, a boy (Liam James) befriends a water-park employee (Sam Rockwell) who helps give him the confidence to come out of his shell.

title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
description: A scientist's quest to find a cure for Alzheimer's disease unintentionally results in a highly intelligent chimpanzee, which may signal the end of man's dominion over Earth.

title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
description: Human survivors of a plague threaten Caesar's growing nation of genetically evolved apes. Though they reach a fragile peace, soon both sides are brought to the brink of a war that will determine which will become Earth's dominant species.

title: War for the Planet of the Apes
description: A ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson) leads his troops in a deadly battle against Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his army of intelligent apes.

title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike.

title: The Flash
description: Worlds collide when the Flash travels back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation.

title: Mickey 17
description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact.

title: Contagion
description: The world panics as doctors race to find a cure for a rapidly spreading virus that kills those contaminated within days.

title: The Daytrippers
description: Family members (Pat McNamara, Anne Meara) join a woman (Hope Davis) on an odyssey to confront her husband about a love letter addressed to him.

title: Adult Best Friends
description: Katie takes her best friend on a nostalgic trip to their hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests.

title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
description: Family tensions arise after a woman (Nia Vardalos) falls in love with a man (John Corbett) who is not Greek.

title: They All Laughed
description: New York private eyes (Ben Gazzara, John Ritter) fall for wives they've been hired by husbands to follow.

title: Shazam!
description: Billy Batson is a streetwise 14-year-old who can magically transform into the adult superhero Shazam simply by shouting out one word. His newfound powers soon get put to the test when he squares off against the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana.

title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
description: When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives and the fate of the world.

title: Robin Hood
description: In twelfth-century England, Robin Longstride and his band of marauders confront corruption in a local village and lead an uprising against the crown that will forever alter the balance of power.

title: The Alto Knights
description: The Alto Knights follow two of New York's most notorious crime bosses and how their separate paths to power place them on a deadly collision course.

title: Broken City
description: A former cop (Mark Wahlberg) becomes embroiled in a bigger scandal than he realized after being hired to tail the cheating wife of the mayor (Russell Crowe).

title: Black Butterfly
description: A down-on-his luck screenwriter picks up a drifter and offers him a place to stay, not knowing that soon he'll become a prisoner, forced to write for a deranged stranger.

title: X-Men: First Class
description: Charles Xavier and Erik Lehnsherr work with other mutants to prevent a nuclear nightmare, but a situation soon tears the close friends apart.

title: The Hangover Part II
description: Hoping to avoid the mayhem that marked his friend's Las Vegas bachelor party, Stu opts for what he thinks will be a safe prewedding brunch in Thailand.

title: Camp Hell
description: Horrific events plague a teen when his parents send him to a Christian camp.

title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem.

title: DC League of Super-Pets
description: Krypto the Super-Dog must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers to help him save Superman and the rest of the Justice League.

title: Life of Pi
description: After the freighter they're on sinks in a storm, a teenager (Suraj Sharma) and a Bengal tiger wind up on a small lifeboat and must learn to trust each other to survive.

title: Head Office
description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter.

title: The Dilemma
description: As an important presentation nears, a business partner (Vince Vaughn) agonizes over whether to tell his associate and friend (Kevin James) that he saw the man's wife out with another guy.

title: The Meg
description: A massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific Ocean. With time running out, a rescue diver must now confront an unimaginable threat, a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark.

title: Friendship
description: A suburban dad falls hard for his new neighbor.

title: Ocean's Eight
description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger.

title: Get Him to the Greek
description: A record-company employee (Jonah Hill) has just a few days to get a boozy British rock star (Russell Brand) to Hollywood for a big comeback concert.

title: MacGruber
description: After his sworn enemy steals a nuclear warhead, a clueless soldier-of-fortune (Will Forte) leads a skilled team on a mission to retrieve the device and bring the thief to justice.

title: Spring Breakers
description: Four college friends (Vanessa Hudgens, Selena Gomez, Ashley Benson, Rachel Korine) are arrested after robbing a restaurant to fund their spring-break trip. They land in more trouble when a drug and arms dealer bails them out to do some dirty work.

title: The Player
description: About 65 real-life movie stars fringe the satire of a Hollywood studio executive (Tim Robbins) who gets away with murder.

title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
description: After a 50-year-old woman's (Frances McDormand) daughter is murdered, she confronts the police (Caleb Landry Jones, Kerry Condon) in her town, using the billboards on the outskirts of town to begin a smear campaign against them.

title: Hoot
description: After moving from Montana, a youth and his new friends in Florida take on corrupt politicians and greedy developers in a fight to protect endangered owls.

title: Isle of Dogs
description: In the future, an outbreak of canine flu leads the mayor of a Japanese city to banish all dogs to an island that's a garbage dump. The outcasts must soon embark on an epic journey when a 12-year-old boy arrives on the island to find his beloved pet.

title: The Switch
description: A woman (Jennifer Aniston) inseminates herself without knowing that her best friend (Jason Bateman) substituted her preferred sperm sample for his own.
